summary: Completed backend + frontend verification for requested Arabic UX updates, unsaved reconciliation navigation guard, Eastern Arabic numerals rendering, SWIFT display, admin login routing with 2FA-setup condition, and setup.exe download validity.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for requested scope.
Optional: split backend/server.py into smaller modules to reduce regression risk.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical functional defect reproduced in requested scope.
backend/server.py is a large monolithic file (>1200 lines), exceeding maintainability guideline threshold and increasing change risk.
Default permission 'manage_reconciliations: true' in user defaults still warrants least-privilege review for future user creation flows.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary reconciliation record with TEST-prefixed period label for API validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public URL from frontend/.env: https://scanner-ocr-test.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin login with default credentials succeeds and currently routes to /secure-admin-control-panel because requires_2fa_setup path is active (not blocked login). Back buttons are present alongside logout in module selection, bank selection, admin page, and bank shell. Reconciliation history remains hidden before year selection and shows 'اختر السنة أولاً'. Unsaved-change modal appears when navigating away after edits; 'تراجع للحفظ' keeps user on reconciliation page and preserves field value, while 'موافق على عدم الحفظ' proceeds to navigation. Eastern Arabic digits appear in rendered summaries while numeric input values remain western digits. SWIFT CODE is visible in bank cards and bank shell header. /api/download/setup returns valid EXE (magic 4d 5a = MZ, size 942936 bytes).
rca of the issue: No issue reproduced for requested scope. Earlier skip-only backend run was due missing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in pytest process environment; resolved by running pytest with the public URL env explicitly set.
